title: Box Class
instructions:
Complete the generic `Box<T>` class. It should:

1. Have a private property called `item` of type `T` (passed in the constructor).
2. Have a method called `getValue()` that returns the `item`.

The tests will create boxes that hold different types to make sure your class works with `Int`, `String`, and `Double`.
hint: The class constructor should take `private val item: T`. The `getValue()` method returns `item` and has return type `T`.
